# Mr. Robert's Fries

> Ghana's most loved loaded fries and crispy chicken. Fresh, hot, delivered fast to Accra and Kumasi.

## About
Mr. Robert's Fries serves hand-cut golden fries loaded with cheese, signature sauces, and proteins. Signature items include The Robert Special Bowl, Gourmet Loaded Bacon & Beef Fries, and Sticky Sweet & Spicy Wings. Orders can be paid with MTN Mobile Money, Telecel Cash, AT Money, or card via Paystack.

## Service Areas
- Accra: East Legon, UG Legon, UPSA, Adjiringanor, Madina, Adenta
- Kumasi: KNUST Campus, Bomso, Ayeduase, Adum, Kejetia

## Hours
Monday–Sunday, 11:00–23:00 (Ghana Time, GMT+0)

## Order Policy
- Delivery fee ranges GH₵ 15–30 depending on zone
- Loyalty program: 1 point per GH₵ 1 spent; 100 points = GH₵ 1 off
- Referral program: Give GH₵ 10, Get GH₵ 10 in loyalty points
